statements.statement: CPT 93247 was denied because required prior authorization was not obtained
The clinical indication note documents recurrent palpitations and exertional dyspnea
The patient has established atherosclerotic heart disease
The patient has nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency
Long-term continuous ECG monitoring was ordered to assess cardiac rhythm over an extended period
The monitoring was ordered to evaluate the correlation between symptoms and potential arrhythmic events
The denial reason code is CO-197
